selection: D6-40 grid search: gradient_boosting {"learning_rate": 0.03, "max_leaf_nodes": 16, "max_iter": 400, "l2_regularization": 1.0, "min_samples_leaf": 5, "ecosystem": true}, highest cross-validated PR-AUC (0.9059); without GuardDog: gradient_boosting {"learning_rate": 0.3, "max_leaf_nodes": 8, "max_iter": 50, "l2_regularization": 1.0, "min_samples_leaf": 5, "ecosystem": true}
decision_rule: 'rule': any review signal raises review and the probability ranks what is held; 'model': the probability at or above the ecosystem-specific threshold, when present, otherwise the global threshold raises review. Global thresholds follow D6-37; PyPI thresholds follow D6-46.
calibration: probability at the training data's malicious share (0.367); real installs have far fewer, so read it as a ranking score, not a real-world probability
